name: POST /api/leadflow/consent/receipts/:receipt_id/revoke - withdraw one consent receipt
description:
Withdraws consent for one receipt, through sdk-consent's POST /api/consents/:receipt_id/revoke.

THE PATH IS PLURAL, AND THE TASK SAID SINGULAR. It specified POST /api/consent/receipts/:receipt_id/revoke; sdk-consent has only ever served /api/consents/:receipt_id/revoke. The same singular/plural slip made the AI coach's recording gate deny every call for weeks, and it read as an outage rather than a typo. Taken from packages/sdk-consent/src/server/routes.ts.

THIS WRITE NEVER DEGRADES, though every read on this feature does. The overview answers honestly when upstream is unreachable - empty panels, upstream_available:false - but a revocation must not: reporting success when nothing was revoked tells a person they have been removed when they have not, and they have no reason to check again. That is the worst outcome available anywhere in this feature. If sdk-consent does not confirm, this answers 502 and the screen keeps the receipt active.

A REASON IS REQUIRED. A withdrawal with no stated reason is the one audit entry a regulator will ask about and find empty. The screen prompts for it as a courtesy so the operator is not bounced by a 400, but the guarantee lives here.

THE CASCADE IS NAMED, NOT CLAIMED (AC3). Revoking emits consent.receipt.revoked.v1, which sdk-data-rights fans out to the erasure surfaces. LeadFlow does not perform that fan-out and must not imply it verified one, so the response reports what it actually knows - the revocation was accepted - and names the event responsible for the propagation rather than asserting the propagation happened.

requiresRole:["privacy_officer"] and NO testCase pins an Authorization header (MUST-71). consent.purpose_manage is held by privacy_officer alone; the local role `privacy` bridges to it and testCredentials.privacy_officer is the account the runner swaps to. Verified live: 200 as the privacy officer, 403 as both data_steward and admin. QA: depends on register and login.

testCases.name: NEGATIVE: a withdrawal with no reason is refused
NEGATIVE: an unconfirmed revocation is reported as failed, never as done

payload.reason: Subject withdrew consent by reply to the last campaign.

errorCases.message: reason is required to revoke consent
errorCases.when: no reason accompanies the withdrawal. A revocation with no stated reason is the audit entry a regulator asks about and finds empty.

errorCases.message: Authorization header with a bearer token is required
errorCases.when: the header is absent or not Bearer. Not authored as a testCase: pinning it would defeat the role swap (MUST-71).

errorCases.message: No policy grants this action to the caller's roles.
errorCases.when: the caller does not hold consent.purpose_manage. Verified live for data_steward and admin, which is the least-privilege separation working as intended.

errorCases.message: sdk-consent did not confirm the revocation, so it cannot be reported as revoked.
errorCases.when: sdk-consent is unreachable or answers without a confirmation. Deliberately NOT degraded to a success: a person told they were removed when they were not has no reason to check again.
